pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided polygonal regions with moderately sharp edge gradients. Individual dark regions on the flank exhibit internal pixel intensity gradients, with darker centers transitioning to lighter brown peripheries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating dark patches. The topological graph consists primarily of tri-radial and four-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the thoracic and upper abdominal regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder transition, formed by the individual terminal hairs of the mane.
